name: Kharnas's Lesser Glyph
source: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
description: A hidden glyph suddenly lights up and dominates the mind of any creature not bearing the sigil of Kharnas the Angel-Binder.
disable: Disable DC 46 Thievery (legendary) to destroy the glyph, DC 42 Arcana (master) to harmlessly divert the glyph's power, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the glyph
reset: The glyph can affect two creatures before it deactivates for 5 minutes and automatically resets.

generalAbilities.name: Dominate
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas attempts to open the door

Effect A surge of the Radiant Spark's latent power courses through the glyph and washes over the triggering creature. If the creature is undead, it takes 10d10 Vitality Damage damage. If it's living, it instead regains 10d10 Healing Damage Hit Points. It then must succeed at a DC 40 Will Saving Throw save or be affected by a 6th-rank Dominate spell.

The spell commands the affected creature to attack the nearest creature who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas.
